mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a foggy 66 degrees near City Hall. We are currently under a first quarter moon, and you can spot the International Space Station tonight starting at 9:17 PM for two minutes, rising in the northwest near the high school and traveling toward the east. The overnight low will be 60 degrees with rain expected.

The city has announced that chip sealing road maintenance begins Wednesday, September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development projects on October 5.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today and the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, head to Badger Prairie County Park for the Bike the Barns fundraiser.
In our weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for an O W I after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a building remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
